value.subject: Question about a January start for Ada
value.body:
Hello,

I'm hoping to enroll Ada, and I would ideally like her to start in January. I see the site currently offers starts on November 21 and November 28, as well as a waitlist for a start on January 9, 2027. Would it be possible for Ada to start in January, and if so, could you tell me how to go about it?

Thank you very much for your time.
